[LTIM.10.6] **The `TimeZoneOffset` schema.** A schema of the built-in module
([LIMP.12.2]), `scope logical ambient` ([LSCP.2.5]): the integrator asserts its
facts, and a rule may match one and must not `emit` or `withdraw` one
([LSCP.2.5.1]). Each fact is one zone's offset over one period. Its identity is
`(zone, valid_from)` ([LFAC.1.7]).

| Slot | Type | Marker | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zone` | `String` | key | the designation the fact resolves, compared byte for byte: no normalisation, and case is significant |
| `valid_from` | `Time` | key | the first instant of the period, inclusive |
| `valid_until` | `Time` | mutable | the end of the period, exclusive |
| `offset_s` | `Int` | mutable | the offset in force over the period, in seconds east of UTC |
